source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    !!!! GPU Sensor need to load related driver first under OS. !!!!
1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.

original_test_intent: With the required platform/accelerator driver state active, exercise the GPU-baseboard FPGA temperature sensor through approved warning and critical thresholds, verify SEL and FPGA-controlled board protection, then prove FPGA, rails, management paths and accelerators recover.
original_method: The Master explicitly uses high-level IPMI SDR/sensor reads while an engineer changes the thermal condition. It does not require raw bytes, identify which FPGA or describe how workload couples to the FPGA rather than only the GPUs.
manual_activity: An engineer identifies the exact FPGA and its board-control responsibilities, confirms the sensor and supported read path, selects a workload or fixture that safely couples heat to that FPGA, and retains physical abort and board-recovery authority.
required_inputs: FPGA vendor/device, physical location, board revision, function/controlled domains, bitstream or firmware build and SDR mapping
standard SDR visibility or documented Project-approved read-only vendor telemetry/decoder
validated GPU/platform driver and FPGA management-tool versions without reprogramming
proof that workload or fixture heats the FPGA sensor rather than only accelerator silicon
temperature limits, hysteresis, SEL event data and expected fan/rail/throttle/shutdown/control-plane behavior
independent probe, FPGA heartbeat/status, rail/sideband/GPU telemetry, abort, cooldown and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not issue guessed raw IPMI bytes, write FPGA registers, load a bitstream or reprogram firmware for this temperature test.
Do not assume a generic GPU workload raises FPGA temperature; prove coupling or use a Project-approved fixture within nearby-component limits.

Continuously monitor FPGA temperature and heartbeat/status, controlled power rails, fans, sideband/management paths, GPU/device visibility, driver/XID, host and BMC; abort on heartbeat loss, rail anomaly, management failure, device loss or overshoot.
Preserve the first SEL, FPGA status, rail, sideband and device failure evidence; do not clear logs, reset the FPGA or auto-retry.
Stop stimulus, restore cooling and verify FPGA control functions, rails, fans, management links, GPUs and host recover before continuation.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, bind TEMP_GB_FPGA to the exact FPGA, bitstream build, SDR and independent probe and baseline every declared control domain.
Use high-level IPMI/SEL plus approved read-only FPGA/status telemetry while running only the authorized FPGA-coupled workload or monitoring engineer-operated thermal equipment.
Correlate warning/critical assert/deassert with FPGA status, rails, fans, management/sideband and GPU/host behavior through cooldown and recovery.
Do not invent raw commands, write registers, reprogram/reset the FPGA, apply physical heat, clear evidence, auto-retry or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve FPGA identity/role, bitstream, sensor/read path, coupling method, limits, event/control-protection matrix and recovery.
Operate physical stimulus with oversight and emergency abort authority.
Resolve any board-control or management-path anomaly and issue the DUT verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The placeholder safely avoids invented raw bytes but incorrectly declares them necessary. The Master high-level SDR/sensor commands must be checked first; it also omits SEL and FPGA-specific health.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Start with trusted `ipmitool sdr elist` and `ipmitool sensor list` plus SEL; correlate with an approved read-only FPGA status/heartbeat interface and independent probe. Use no write or reprogram operation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The driver note, FPGA target, high-level IPMI commands, threshold-crossing requirement, script and 5/10-minute values remain; no raw bytes or configuration action are introduced.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT FPGA IDENTITY AND COUPLING PLAN REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the sensor to the exact FPGA/bitstream and control domains, verify the read-only path, apply a bounded coupled workload or fixture, correlate SEL/control health, then cool and prove all controlled functions recover.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact GPU baseboard, FPGA implementation/bitstream, controlled power/fan/sideband domains and cooling layout.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board revision, FPGA device/bitstream, BMC/SDR, platform/GPU firmware and driver, telemetry tool and fixture/workload versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor FPGA thermal limits, sensor/status interface, bitstream support matrix, board-control event mapping and recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds FPGA/bitstream identity, heat-coupling proof, heartbeat/rail/sideband evidence and explicit no-reprogram boundary without replacing Master commands.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A changing GPU temperature or readable FPGA sensor alone cannot prove the FPGA control plane and every affected board domain remained healthy and recovered.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: FPGA identity/role, read-only interface, qualified coupling, limits/events and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Thermal stress at a control FPGA may disrupt power sequencing, fan control, sideband communication or accelerator visibility before the BMC sensor reaches its critical limit.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may approve a vendor read-only tool and workload/chamber/fixture, but must record the original high-level commands, actual method, equivalence and uncovered FPGA-controlled domains. Firmware load, register write or reset is outside this test unless separately approved.
expected_evidence: FPGA device/location/board role/bitstream build, SDR and independent-probe identity map
standard-command visibility or approved read-only vendor interface/decoder contract
approved workload or fixture coupling, nearby-component limits and abort record
timestamped FPGA/BMC/probe temperatures, SEL, heartbeat/status, rails, fans, sideband/management, GPU/XID and host evidence
decoded warning/critical assert/deassert and any protection timing
no FPGA configuration change, cooldown, restored control functions/rails/links/devices/host/BMC health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The unique Master row consistently identifies FPGA thermal behavior and explicit high-level IPMI reads. FPGA mapping and read-tool details are Project readiness inputs; the raw-byte assertion exists only in prior review advice and is rejected rather than treated as a Master-source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The FPGA target, dynamic thermal operation and criteria are identifiable. Exact FPGA/bitstream identity, role, supported telemetry, coupling method and safe limits are supplyable Project inputs, enabling attended stimulus and automated monitoring.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 and rejects the inherited raw-command premise.

review_improvement: Makes the thermal result attributable to a specific FPGA build and verifies the board-control functions whose failure could precede a visible temperature alarm.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source provides a clear FPGA thermal target and usable baseline commands. Project hardware data can identify the FPGA and safe coupling method. Physical stimulus and control-plane recovery remain engineer-owned, while synchronized sensor, SEL and board-health collection are automatable after readiness inputs are supplied.
